title: Blue Lock Season 3 Heads to Neo Egoist League With Key Visual Starring Isagi and Kaiser
content: BLUE LOCK Season 3 revealed its title to be BLUE LOCK: Neo Egoist League along with a key visual starring Isagi Yoichi and Michael Kaiser. Special character visuals were also revealed for the two players, who will be the key characters in the upcoming season.
author: Anime Corner

title: EXCLUSIVE: X² - Double X OVA Gets 1st-Ever Digital Release on Crunchyroll, X Japan's Yoshiki Talks to ANN About Work's Significance
content: Crunchyroll will exclusively stream a remastered version of the X² - Double X OVA project based on CLAMP 's X/1999 franchise worldwide (outside of Japan, China, and South Korea) starting on June 10 at 3:00 p.m. EDT.
author: ANN

title: Live-Action In the Clear Moonlit Dusk Film's Trailer Reveals More Cast
content: The official website for the live-action film of Mika Yamamori 's In the Clear Moonlit Dusk ( Uruwashi no Yoi no Tsuki ) manga began streaming a new trailer for the film on Monday. The trailer reveals more cast members for the film.
author: ANN

title: Japanese Animation TV Ranking, May 25-31
content: Hirokazu Kore-eda 's live-action film of Akimi Yoshida 's Umimachi Diary / Our Little Sister manga aired on Fuji TV on Saturday, May 30 at 9:00 p.m. and earned a 5.4% rating. title: U-KNOCK 2026 Japan Summit to Spotlight Korea-Japan Content Industry Collaboration
content: A Korea-Japan content industry summit will be held in Tokyo this July, bringing together companies and stakeholders across webtoon, web novel, film, animation, and K-pop sectors.
author: ANN

title: Webtoon-Based Live-Action Series 'One-of-a-Kind Romance' to Debut in 2nd Half of 2026
content: Production company Corpus Korea confirmed on June 2 that the One-of-a-Kind Romance webtoon is getting a live-action adaptation that will premiere in the second half of the year on TVING, with additional distribution on Viu in Hong Kong and ABEMA in Japan.
author: ANN

title: 'Draw This, Then Die!' Anime's 2nd Promo Video Reveals Ending Song
content: The official website for the television anime of Minoru Toyoda 's Draw This, Then Die! ( Kore Kaite Shine ) manga started streaming the anime's second promotional video on Monday, which reveals and previews the ending theme song "Conifer" by Regal Lily . The band specifically wrote the song for the anime.
author: ANN

title: Tamamori's Fantasies Never Stop Manga's Tatsuwaipu Launches New Series
content: Kodansha 's YanMaga Web platform announced on June 1 that Tamamori's Fantasies Never Stop! creator Tatsuwaipu will launch a new series titled Deriheru Yondara Moto Dōkyūsei ga Kita (When I Called an Escort Service, My Former Classmate Came) on the platform on June 13. The manga will update on Saturdays.
author: ANN

title: Chronoscript: The Endless End Action Game Launches This Fall
content: DeskWorks announced during the "Future Games Show: Summer Showcase" livestream on Saturday that Chronoscript: The Endless End , its new action-adventure game , will launch for the PlayStation 5 and PC via Steam in fall 2026. A thousand year long story that refuses to end.
author: ANN

title: Blue Exorcist Manga Returns on July 3
content: The July issue of Shueisha 's Jump SQ. magazine announced on Thursday that Kazue Katō 's Blue Exorcist manga will resume serialization in the next issue on July 3. Katō also reported on Thursday that she has started drawing chapter 167 (after mistakenly saying it was chapter "178").
author: ANN
